The upper, widest portion of the room holds the main conversation and media group: three sofas form a U-shaped arrangement around the coffee table, with the primary sofa facing the wall-mounted side of the TV cabinet. The TV rests on the cabinet, and two side tables flank the cabinet so it lies between them. The other side tables sit beside the upper sofa.

The dining combination occupies the middle-left area, leaving the projecting entrance area and a route along the right side unobstructed. The wine cabinet and stool use the quieter lower room without blocking its doors or window. The bonsai is placed against the left wall between the dining and living zones. Clear gaps connect all three zones and keep the floor immediately inside each door free.
[/Reason]
</reasoning>
